role_discovery.unknown_fields: ignored silently by the host; the conformance test therefore checks each emitted key against this list

dispatch.mechanism: Agent tool invoked from the root session
dispatch.nesting_default: up to 3 layers below the main conversation
dispatch.nesting_control: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH; the adapter also withholds the Agent tool from every generated role so dispatch stays flat
dispatch.headless: claude -p ... --agents '<inline JSON>' ; a file path for --agents requires 2.1.281 or later

receipt_observability.child_identity: observable: an agent id is returned to the parent on completion; transcripts are written under ~/.claude/projects/<project>/<session>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl
receipt_observability.usage_and_cost: not exposed to the controller; recorded as unknown

tool_restrictions.mechanism: tools allowlist and disallowedTools denylist in frontmatter
tool_restrictions.default: subagents inherit the parent's tools, including MCP tools

permission_behavior.per_role_override_exists: permissionMode field; the adapter never sets bypass or auto modes
permission_behavior.isolation_note: A tools allowlist narrows what a role can call. It is not a sandbox and not a security boundary against a hostile user of the same machine.

human_input_attestation: not available to the controller; approvals recorded through the CLI are unattested
notes: Live validation is possible on the build machine. Results are recorded in docs/compatibility/claude-code.md only from actual runs.
